phase: Single worldboss-active query per home snapshot
findings: homeViewSnapshot built the event list and the worldboss slot separately.
events() queried v110MysticEventActive and worldBossEventActive queried the same API again, so every home signature check called the same event predicate twice.
changes: The resolved boolean is passed into events() and reused for the worldboss slot/signature.
Standalone diagnostics can still call events() without arguments and keep the same behavior.
No event schedule, rewards, boss attempts, or server authority changed.
